To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the ownership structure and the board characteristics have a significant impact on the performance of Botswana listed firms.
the ownership structure, corporate governance, firm specific and market specific variables have a significant effect on the financial performance of the firms listed in the Botswana Stock Exchange.
the board structure, ownership concentration and ownership structure are important in explaining the performance of firms listed on BSE.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between the corporate governance mechanisms and the performance of the firms in an emerging economy, Botswana, and the role of the stock market in such an economy.
the relationship between ownership structure, board composition and firm performance.
the relationship of ownership concentration and corporate governance with firm performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ownership structure, corporate governance, and firm performance are related in an emerging market like Botswana.
corporate governance in Botswana is still at its infancy.
corporate governance in the form of board characteristics and ownership structure is not associated with the performance of the firms in Botswana.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ownership structure is an important factor for corporate governance and the financial performance.
the ownership structure and board characteristics do not affect the firm performance in Botswana.
corporate governance has a positive impact on performance in Botswana.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the relationship between ownership structure and firm performance is not a linear function of ownership structure.
the relationship among corporate governance and firm characteristics is not linear.
there is a significant relationship among ownership structure, board size and firm performance.
